notes: Potential no-go evidence was observed but contradicted by retained normal-site evidence, so the scan continued.

interpretation: The three-site targeted cohort has 10 unresolved checks before and after: two resolved, offset by two newly unresolved checks. No aggregate coverage gain is claimed.
CookieYes configured-name completeness resolves its partial missing-declaration comparison without inventing descriptions.
Cookiebot retains a richer 87-name manifest, separate from 61 detailed declaration records; loaded DOM remains partial.

The fresh visits all had usable overall runtime coverage. Streaming and unsettled-document fixtures verify early capture and the independent cookie-snapshot path; no live unsettled-window improvement is inferred from this cohort.
Cookiebot representative consent visuals were withheld after safety-review finalization deadlines. The earlier available image cannot be substituted for an unverified later pairing.
OneTrust privacy link hit testing missed after its permitted scroll, so accessibility is not inferred from the historical successful visit.

The continued OneTrust diagnostic visit retains its immutable-loader-bound point-in-time cookie comparison. This does not authorize broader missing-declaration Review from a challenged runtime lane. Canonical No-Go visits and unverifiable new proofs remain ineligible.
